newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PAPIN TAKES BORDEAUX TO TOP OF FRENCH LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PAPIN TAKES BORDEAUX TO TOP OF FRENCH LEAGUE.

text.p: Spurred by a rejuvenated Jean-Pierre Papin, Bordeaux beat Lille 3-0 to move to the top of the French league on Saturday.
Papin, a former European footballer ot the year, scored with a fine header in the 76th minute, bringing his side one point clear of Paris St Germain, who travel to Cannes on Sunday.
Bordeaux, who like PSG are unbeaten in the league this season, are on 15 points.
It is the first time in more than five years that Bordeaux have taken the top spot and their renaissance coincides with Papin's.
Since the league resumed last month, the former Marseille marksman, who spent three disappointing seasons away from France with AC Milan and Bayern, has scored four goals.
He also set up Bordeaux's first goal against Lille, crossing for Didier Tholot, who scored just after the break. Tholot made it three in the dying minutes of the match.
But Papin, 32, who was France's top marksman three times in a row between 1988 and 1991, has a dangerous rival in Bastia's Anton Drobnjak, who scored twice in Bastia's 3-1 victory away in Strasbourg.
Drobnjak has scored six goals since the start of the season.
The victory was all the more important for Bordeaux as other leading teams playing on Saturday night failed to win.
Lens, who were the early pacesetters in the league, again lost away at Guingamp 1-0 while champions Auxerre conceded a goalless draw at newly promoted Nancy.

Less than two years after winning an unexpected league title, Nantes are going through hard times. Unable to win a single match out of seven this season, the Canaries again lost at home to Metz and are now in 18th place.
